_meta.algorithm: REINFORCE with learned baseline (A2C critic); one policy net per arm
_meta.reward: r_t = w_j*1[C_j<=due_j]/W per dispatch; sum = weighted on-time rate
_meta.selector: held fixed per arm (A slack, B risk); only the reserve b is learned
_meta.pass_rule: mean of S2,S3 test delta vs baseline >= 0.020 AND both paired 95% CI lower > 0
_meta.test_once: test seeds evaluated exactly once, after both arms are frozen

train_runs.note: recorded from _progress.curves of the first run (default hyperparameters)

_meta.selection: best validation score (mean of S2,S3 greedy deltas over val seeds) across training runs A-C; the run-C checkpoint is written to data/up_p3_rl_ckpt.pt and is the one evaluated on test; no test seed was touched before the final stage

params.net: MLP 36-128-128 (tanh) -> 13 action logits + 1 state value = 23,054 params
params.advantage: reward-to-go minus learned value, normalised per batch
params.episodes_per_epoch: 2 sampled rollouts x 3 cases x 15 train seeds = 90 trajectories/epoch
params.early_stop: validation score must improve within 400 epochs
params.selection: best validation score across runs A-C; run C checkpoint evaluated on test once

ledger.headline: S2 +5.0 / S3 -6.9 pt, fail
ledger.source: params from up_p3_rl_ckpt.pt; epochs = frozen best epoch of the reported arm; gpu_seconds = gpu_train_seconds (three runs); headline from paired deltas

verdict.reason: mean test delta vs baseline = -0.9375 pp on S2 +0.0500 (CI95 0.1526, lower -0.1026), S3 -0.0688 (CI95 0.1487, lower -0.2175); n_test=5; rule >= 0.0200 and both lower > 0 -> FAIL
verdict.gate_rule: mean of S2,S3 test delta vs baseline >= 0.020 AND both paired 95% CI lower > 0
verdict.gate_evaluated_on: primary arm A (slack selector), test seeds 2026111725-2026111729, single pass
verdict.diagnosis: Reserve-only training cannot clear the pre-registered gate on 5 test seeds. The same pairing on the 10 val seeds already gives lower<0 (S2 -0.0059, S3 -0.0228), so the failure is structural, not a test-slice accident: with weights 1-3 the weighted on-time rate moves in lumps of 1/W, 2-3 of 5 seeds are unchanged, and the paired sd (12.3pp / 12.0pp) is 2.5x the effect. The grid corner q0.30 (the best fixed reserve found on val) gives S2 +6.7pp / S3 +0.6pp on the same test seeds, so no reserve-only policy of this family reaches +2.0pp on both cases there. What the two arms do show is an interaction: the learned reserve is nearly constant (level 3 = q0.45, 96% of greedy decisions) under the slack selector, but genuinely state-dependent under the risk selector (q0.35 dominant on S2, q0.30 on S3), and that arm improves S2 by +9.2pp vs slack_old while tying S3.

_detail.note: q30_diagnostic is post-hoc (no selection used it).  Arm A shares the baseline selector, so its delta isolates the reserve decision; arm B vs the tuned rule does the same on the strongest selector.
